caption: A robot vacuum travels the length of a corridor lit by a single ceiling light, and its shadow on the floor changes side as it passes beneath the light.

sa.check: A robot vacuum travels along a corridor.
The corridor is lit by a ceiling light.
Its shadow on the floor changes side as it passes beneath the light.
There is a single ceiling light.
The vacuum travels the corridor's length.

pc.expect: The shadow is ahead of the vacuum before the light and behind it after, always pointing away from the bulb.
pc.fail: It stays on one side the whole way; or points toward the bulb; or switches sides at the wrong place.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the vacuum's round outline, short beneath the light and longer away from it.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or one length throughout; or it splits.

pc.expect: The vacuum moves steadily and the shadow only with it.
pc.fail: The shadow moves with the vacuum stopped; or the vacuum jumps position; or the shadow drifts.

pc.expect: The shadow is attached at the vacuum's base and lies on the floor.
pc.fail: It floats detached; or it appears on the ceiling; or it is missing under the light.

pc.expect: One vacuum, one light and one shadow.
pc.fail: A second shadow appears under one light; or the vacuum vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the vacuum passes through a wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The vacuum and the corridor stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The vacuum changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the corridor changes.
